authority.note: Re-enablement requires evidence-backed release capability generation, not a Boolean change (ADR-0002).

election.platform_based_election: REJECTED (would contradict the frozen contract; needs the scoped amendment procedure)
election.rule: unsigned-lexicographic smaller node_hint retains central/initiator; equal fails closed

limitations: Android -> backgrounded-iOS discovery is structurally impossible (Apple overflow area; ADR-002 section 2.1). Recorded as a limitation, never a capability.
iOS-Android links require at least one Android device in range; an all-iOS backgrounded group is a degraded mesh.
iBeacon-format relaunch requires Apple licensing review (open compliance item; legal, not engineering).
No physical device matrix case 0-10 has been run; HARDWARE gate open. BLE only tells the truth on real radios.
Cipher suite stays BLAKE2s; ADR-007 remains PROPOSED without approval and independent A06 review remains open.

BULK.note: Not a production route; Wi-Fi bulk plane work is lab-scoped (ADR-006).

LAB_MESH.note: Non-shipping mesh lab; frozen LinkInfo election applies; delivery substrate C8.4D1-R2 and trusted driver C8.4D2 remain OPEN.

LAB_ORACLE.note: Native models remain an external gate (NATIVE_MODELS); no private draft may leak into shipping LIGHT.

LIGHT.note: LIGHT is the only initial tier; mesh/oracle/bulk/SOS are not production routes and receive no permissions, entitlements, services, background modes or marketing claims.

SOS.note: Not a production route; atomic SOS remains behind the mesh engine gates.
